root_cause.text: Missing validation of the AAD length (assoclen) in crypto_authenc_esn_decrypt() and crypto_authenc_esn_encrypt(), which assume an ESP/ESN-formatted AAD of at least 8 bytes, allowing a crafted short AAD to cause an out-of-bounds scatterlist access and trigger a NULL pointer dereference.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds explicit checks `if (assoclen < 8) return -EINVAL;` in both functions, and the commit description explains that without this check, `crypto_authenc_esn_decrypt()` can advance past the end of the destination scatterlist, leading to a NULL pointer dereference in `scatterwalk_map_and_copy()`.
